item.title: Volkswagen’s new entry-level EV may not be so cheap after all
item.description: The ID. Polo is arriving in 2026 as the first of a new family of entry-level Volkswagen EVs. It was initially expected to start at 25,000 euros ($30,000), but that may no longer be the case. At least, not right away. more…

item.title: EV battery leader CATL is gearing up for sodium-ion batteries in 2026
item.description: CATL is already dominating the global electric vehicle battery market, but now the company is saying sodium-ion batteries will be widely available by the end of 2026. more…

item.title: New California law will target the parents of child e-bike riders
item.description: Another year and another set of e-bike restrictions. California riders are about to see some notable changes, as several new e-bike and electric motorcycle laws are set to take effect next week. Beginning January 1, 2026, a package of safety-focused regulations will officially go live, aimed at addressing the rapid growth of electric micromobility across the state. more…

item.title: $29K Dodge Charger — is this 50% off EV deal too good to miss?
item.description: We talk all about the whys and hows behind the all-electric Dodge Charger failing to light up the sales boards the way it lit up its rear tires, but with a base price around $60,000 it hardly seemed to matter — now that Dodge dealers are slashing prices by nearly 50%, however, is this retro EV finally worth a look? more…

item.title: EIA: All net new generating capacity in 2026 may be renewables
item.description: During the first 10 months of 2025, solar and battery storage have dominated growth among competing energy sources. Further, all net new generating capacity in 2026 is forecast to be provided by renewable energy and batteries, according to data recently released by the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reviewed by the SUN DAY Campaign. more…

item.title: Is now the best time to buy an EV as year-end deals wrap up?
item.description: Is the end of the year the best time to buy a vehicle? With some older EV models piling up on the lot, you might be able to score some extra savings. more…

item.title: Google just spent $4.75B chasing power for AI data centers
item.description: Alphabet is buying energy and data center developer Intersect for $4.75 billion in cash, plus the assumption of debt – a clear signal that securing power, not just servers, has become one of Google’s biggest bottlenecks as AI demand explodes. more…

item.title: Tesla (TSLA) does something unsual ahead of Q4 delivery results
item.description: In a surprising move, Tesla (TSLA) has publicly released a delivery consensus for the fourth quarter of 2025 via a press release on its investor relations website. This is a significant departure from the automaker’s standard operating procedure, suggesting it is trying to get ahead of what looks to be a disappointing quarter. more…
